MY JOURNEY
MY STORY

I was tired of spending my free time in the hostel just scrolling.

I had hours between lectures, evenings after class, and weekends where I wasn’t really doing much with my time. And I kept thinking — if I’m already spending this much time online, why not use some of it to build something that could actually make me money?

I wanted to earn my own money, make my own decisions, and rely on myself a little more.

That’s when I started learning about digital products and experimenting with simple ways to create something once and sell it online. What started as a way to make my first $100 eventually became something much bigger.

Since then, I’ve generated $8,021.95 in gross sales in just 2 weeks — and learned a process that I now want to make simple for other students.

QUESTIONS

Frequently asked.

Do I need experience?

No. The page is designed around a beginner-friendly process, so you can start with knowledge or skills you already have.

Do I need a big audience?

No. A large audience can help, but the focus is on simple ways to reach potential customers without relying on thousands of followers.

What can I sell?

Examples include ebooks, guides, templates, checklists, planners, educational resources and other downloadable products.

How fast can I make $100?

There is no guaranteed timeline. Your results depend on your product, offer, marketing and execution. The goal is to give you a clear system to work toward your first $100.
